# CF-01 RepoDNA Reference and License Notice

## Reviewed source

- Repository: `DocDamage/RepoDNA`
- Reviewed revision: `2e55216e950692c33c8f47b65beb66a6758ed99a`
- License at that revision: MIT
- Review date: `2026-08-23`

CF-01 uses RepoDNA as a design reference for deterministic repository architecture concepts. The implementation in AI Chatbot Hub is a project-owned TypeScript implementation built around the existing `ApprovedRepositoryGateway`, language registry, parsers, symbol index, build-system detection, and tool registry. RepoDNA Python source was not copied into the chatbot.

The architecture snapshot records this exact source revision and `copiedSource: false`. Any future direct adaptation must identify the exact source file and retain this notice plus the upstream MIT terms.
